modo.Dica: On this device: hides the map, sound and Foundry interface, showing only the character sheet, in a single column, and the chat. Automatic: on phones and tablets, never for the GM. Can also be forced via URL: /game?t20fm=1 or ?t20fm=0.

zoom.Dica: Enlarges or shrinks the content on this device.

tempoAviso.Dica: How long the new or updated message notification stays over the sheet. 0 turns it off; the red dot on the Chat button remains.

manterTelaLigada.Dica: Prevents the phone from turning off the screen during the game. Requires Foundry over HTTPS.

Fundo.SemPersonagem: You don't have a character yet. Ask the GM to assign one to your user or give you Owner permission.
